commands.name: loader-path
argv: if [ -e /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2 ]; then ls -l /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2; else echo MISSING; fi

commands.name: sysctl-ptrace_scope
argv: if [ -r /proc/sys/kernel/yama/ptrace_scope ]; then echo -n /proc/sys/kernel/yama/ptrace_scope=; cat /proc/sys/kernel/yama/ptrace_scope; else echo UNREADABLE /proc/sys/kernel/yama/ptrace_scope; fi
